verdicts.why: Most sentences (danced with her twice, thought it necessary to turn back, taken the trouble of this journey) carry the surprise sense listed first, and the rest lean on the emphasis or in-fact senses, so the first sense is one of the split.

senses.why: Learner line 'at the present time; now.' matches the gloss 'at present'; the example ('actually being broadcast at this moment') is present-time use of the headword, the labels are empty, and null connotation is right for a plain time adverb.
